يعتمدوا (form VIII)
# يَعْتَمِدُوا (yaʕtamidū) /jaʕ.ta.mi.duː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَمَدَ (iʕtamada)
# يُعْتَمَدُوا (yuʕtamadū) /juʕ.ta.ma.duː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَمَدَ (iʕtamada)
